items.headline: Korea me Russi vimaan par alert, phir wapas
items.detail: Ulleung dweep par subah 7:52 baje evacuation alert jaari hua aur 3 minute me wapas liya gaya; sena ne saaf kiya Russi vimaan KADIZ me aaye the, hawai kshetra ka ullanghan nahi hua aur ladaku vimaan bheje gaye.
items.exam_angle: KADIZ aur hawai kshetra ka antar — UPSC IR

items.headline: NATO bhejega Poland ko AWACS vimaan
items.detail: Shukravar ko teen Russi missile Poland me girne ke baad NATO ne early-warning AWACS vimaan bhejne ka faisla kiya; Poland ke up-raksha mantri ne Brussels me elan kiya aur SACEUR ne tainati ko manzoori di.
items.exam_angle: NATO AWACS, Poland-Russia tanav — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: Timothy A. Gonsalves, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

items.headline: America ne Iran ki shadow banking par pratibandh
items.detail: America ke Vitt Mantralaya ne Somvar ko Iran ke shadow banking network se jude do dozen se zyada exchange house, front company aur vyaktiyon par pratibandh lagaye; FinCEN ke mutabik January 2025 se August 2026 tak lagbhag $14.7 arab ki gatividhi is network se judi mili.
items.exam_angle: Pratibandh, shadow banking — UPSC IR/Economy

items.headline: EU ka Russia par 22va pratibandh package
items.detail: European Commission ne 60 Russian banks ko SWIFT se hatane, crypto aur shadow fleet par sakht pratibandh ka prastav rakha; sabhi 27 deshon ki sahamati zaroori.
items.exam_angle: UPSC: EU pratibandh, SWIFT, shadow fleet — Bharat-Russia vyapar par asar

items.headline: ICJ: Myanmar ne Rohingya par narsanhar kiya
items.detail: 9-6 faisle me court ne 2017 ke sainya abhiyan ko narsanhar mana; pehli baar kisi desh ko doshi thahraya gaya aur vapsi aur muavze ka aadesh diya.
items.exam_angle: UPSC: ICJ, Genocide Convention, Gambia v. Myanmar — pehla state-responsibility faisla
items.image_credit: International Court of Justice; originally uploaded by Yeu Ninje at en.wikipedia — Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)

items.headline: Ukraine ne Libya me Russian yuddhapot duboya
items.detail: Ravivar ko samudri drone se Libiya bandargah me Russian korvet duboya gaya; Zelenskyy ne pushti ki, yuddh ka daira Europe se bahar badha.
items.exam_angle: UPSC: Ukraine yuddh ka daira — Libya, samudri drone yuddh

items.headline: COP31 bina samjhaute ke khatm
items.detail: Antalya me jeevashm indhan ka ullekh na karne wale draft ko EU aur 130 deshon ne kharij kar diya; vaarta bina antim ghoshna ke samapt hui.
items.exam_angle: UPSC: COP31, jeevashm indhan phase-out, jalvayu vitt — Bharat ke liye sabak

items.headline: Manchester concert me gas, 12,000 nikale
items.detail: Don Toliver ke show ke dauran Co-op Live arena me 'agyat padarth' chhoda gaya; 12,000 se zyada log nikale gaye, 50 se zyada logon ka ilaaj hua aur ek ko aspatal le jaya gaya, jaanch jaari hai.

items.headline: Kyiv kshetra me hamle, 15 mare
items.detail: Dymer me paanch-manzila imarat par hamle me 11, Vyshneve supermarket me 3 aur Bila Tserkva me 1 vyakti mara; Zelenskyy ne America se Patriot missile ki maang dohrai.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, nagrik nuksan, Patriot — UPSC IR

items.headline: Russia ke parmanu upgrah par NATO satark
items.detail: German media ki report ke mutabik Russia 'Sputnik-S' parmanu hathiyaar wala upgrah kuchh hafton me launch kar sakta hai; NATO pramukh Rutte ne antariksh me raksha ka bharosa diya, Kremlin ne aarop kharij kiye.
items.exam_angle: Antariksh hathiyaar, Outer Space Treaty 1967 — UPSC IR/S&T

items.headline: Democrats ko 1992 ke baad sabse badi jeet
items.detail: North Carolina ki seat jeetne ke baad Democrats ke paas House me kam se kam 258 seatein hain — 1992 ke baad sabse zyada; Senate me bhi 56 seatein, 3 January ko shapath.
items.exam_angle: America madhyaavdhi chunav, Congress, vibhajit sarkar — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gukesh-Sindarov: sabse yuva chess final
items.detail: Vishwa Chess Championship ka pehla game aaj Geneva me khela jayega; dono khiladi 20 saal ke hain, itihaas ka sabse yuva final hai.
items.exam_angle: Vishwa Chess Championship, sabse yuva final — UPSC sports
items.image_credit: Frans Peeters / CC BY-SA 2.0, Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Iowa visfot ko court ki hari jhandi
items.detail: Court ne paryavaran samoohon ki yachika kharij kar di; sena Budhvaar ko Iowa plant me 68 barrel lead azide ka niyantrit visfot karegi.

items.headline: Mahila World Cup 2031 America me
items.detail: FIFA ne 2031 Mahila World Cup America, Mexico, Costa Rica aur Jamaica ko diya; 2035 ka UK me hoga aur pehli baar 48 team khelegi.
items.exam_angle: Mahila World Cup 48 team, pehli baar chaar mezban — UPSC sports

items.headline: Zanzibar me aag, 6 hotel jale
items.detail: Nungwi Beach par Makofi Hotel se shuru hui aag 6 hotel tak phaili; lagbhag 180 paryatak surakshit nikale gaye, kuchh hotel karmchari ghayal hue, jaanch jaari hai.

items.headline: Indonesia factory aag me 24 mare
items.detail: Banten ki candy factory me Shanivaar shaam lagi aag me 24 log mare, lagbhag 30 laapata hain; AC short circuit se aag lagne ki aashanka hai.
items.exam_angle: Factory aag me 24 mare, 30 laapata — aapda prabandhan

items.headline: Zaporizhzhia hamle me 2 mare, 22 ghayal
items.detail: Raat bhar ke hamle me Zaporizhzhia ki paanch-manzila imarat ko nuksan pahuncha; 2 log mare, 22 ghayal hue jinme 6 aur 16 saal ke do bachche bhi hain, adhikariyon ne bataya.

items.headline: Iran me gaayika ko 74 kode
items.detail: Gaayika Parastoo Ahmadi aur unki team ke chaar sadasyon ko bina hijab online concert karne par Qom me 74-74 kode mare gaye; kalatmak gatividhiyon aur yatra par do saal ki rok bhi lagi.
items.exam_angle: Iran, hijab kanoon aur mahila adhikar — UPSC

items.headline: Iowa visfot ko court ki hari jhandi
items.detail: Trump ne pehle visfot rokne ka order diya, phir court ne stay hataya; sena ne Budhvaar subah Iowa plant me 68 barrel lead azide ke niyantrit visfot ki pushti ki. (Update)

items.headline: Hasina 16 December ko Bangladesh lautengi
items.detail: Do saal se zyada ke nirvaasan ke baad poorv PM Sheikh Hasina ne 16 December ko Dhaka lautne ki yojana ghoshit ki; unhone sarkar se Biman Bangladesh Airlines se Delhi se Dhaka ki udaan ki maang ki hai, jabki Dhaka ne kaha hai ki lautne par unhe giraftaar kiya jayega.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh: Hasina ki wapsi aur Victory Day

items.headline: Nepal me 5.3 ka bhukamp, Bharat tak jhatke
items.detail: Mangalvaar subah 7:02 baje Nepal ke Koshi pradesh me 5.3 teevrata ka bhukamp aaya; uttar Bengal, Sikkim, Bhutan aur Bangladesh tak jhatke mehsoos hue aur log ghar se bahar nikle.
items.exam_angle: Himalaya me bhukamp — aapda prabandhan

items.headline: Shenzhou-24: pehla videshi yantri Tiangong jayega
items.detail: China ka Shenzhou-24 yaan Budhvaar subah 8:18 baje Beijing samay par Tiangong station ke liye udega; Pakistani payload specialist Muhammad Zeeshan Ali station par jaane wale pehle videshi yantri banege aur lagbhag ek hafta wahaan rahenge.
items.exam_angle: China ka antariksh station, pehla videshi yantri

items.headline: IRGC ka dawa: Hormuz me 3 tanker mine se takraye
items.detail: Iran ki Revolutionary Guard ne dawa kiya ki Hormuz jaldamroomadhya me teen tel tanker samudri mine se takrakar aag ki lapet me aa gaye; is dawe ki swatantra pushti abhi baaki hai aur US Central Command ne koi pratikriya nahi di hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz — duniya ki tel supply ka raasta

items.headline: Russia ki Estonia ko khule yuddh ki chetavni
items.detail: Russia ke videsh mantralaya ne Estonia par 'khule yuddh' ke kagaar par hone ka aarop lagaya; Estonia 1 December se Russia se seema band kar raha hai aur aaropon ko kharij karta hai.
items.exam_angle: NATO–Russia tanaav: Baltic suraksha

items.headline: Germany ke 450 schools ko bomb ki dhamki
items.detail: Somvaar subah Germany ke 450 se zyada schools ko 'Death awaits you' vishay wale email se bomb ki dhamki mili; police ko koi vaastavik khatra nahi mila aur Denmark ke schools ko bhi aisi dhamki mili.
items.exam_angle: Europe me hybrid warfare aur afwah

items.headline: Gaza ke ghayal bachche UK ilaaj ko pahunche
items.detail: Gaza se gambhir roop se ghayal bachchon ka doosra samooh UK pahuncha, jahan NHS aspatalon me unka vishesh ilaaj hoga; pichhle saal bhi 50 bachche ilaaj ke liye laaye gaye the.
items.exam_angle: Gaza manaviya sankat: chikitsa nikasi

items.headline: UAE me bus-truck takkar, 11 mare
items.detail: Ras Al Khaimah me Al Watan Road par bus aur truck ki takkar me 11 log mare; jaanch jaari hai.

items.headline: Indonesia: poorv police chief par deshdroh ka aarop
items.detail: Indonesia police ne poorv police chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo samet 6 adhikariyon par rashtrapati ki jasusi aur deshdroh ka aarop lagaya; doshi paye jaane par maut ki saza tak ho sakti hai.
items.exam_angle: Deshdroh kanoon aur uski saza — Bharat ke BNS se tulna

items.headline: Trump kal NATO chief Rutte se milenge
items.detail: White House ne kaha Trump budhwar ko Florida me NATO mahasachiv Mark Rutte se milenge; Putin aur Xi se mulakaat ke baad Ukraine par charcha hogi.
items.exam_angle: NATO aur Ukraine vaarta — antarrashtriya sambandh

items.headline: Tajikistan ne ICC chhodne ki prakriya shuru ki
items.detail: Tajikistan ICC se hatne wala chauntha desh bana; America ke dabav ke baad Chad, Venezuela aur Naoero bhi peeche hate.
items.exam_angle: ICC aur Rome Statute — antarrashtriya kanoon

items.headline: Amnesty: Tigray golabari yuddh apraadh ho sakti hai
items.detail: Amnesty ne kaha Ethiopia ki sena ne Tigray ke Alamata me nagrik bastiyon par golabari ki; 14 nagrikon ki maut ki pushti hui, jaanch yuddh apraadh ke roop me honi chahiye.
items.exam_angle: Yuddh apraadh aur antarrashtriya manavtavadi kanoon

items.headline: Gaza hamle me UNRWA karmchari samet 3 mare
items.detail: Somvaar ko Gaza ke Jabalia camp me Israeli hamle me UNRWA karmchari Adel Al-Helo samet kam se kam 3 log mare gaye, 3 ghayal hue.

items.headline: Iran: US nakabandi ka har tarike se jawab
items.detail: Iran ke videsh mantri ke pravakta Baghaei ne kaha, Tehran America ki nausena nakabandi ko sainya hamla manta hai aur har upaay se iska jawab dega.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz jaladmaru — duniya ki urja suraksha se juda

items.headline: Trump ne Iowa visfot par rok lagayi
items.detail: Rashtrapati Trump ne Iowa plant me zehrele lead azide ke visfot ko adalat ke faisle tak rokne ka aadesh diya.

items.headline: Germany Ukraine ke Delta system ka istemal karega
items.detail: Germany aur Ukraine ne sahmati-patra par hastakshar kiye, jisse German sena Kyiv ke Delta yuddh-prabandhan system ka upyog kar sakegi.

items.headline: Zaporizhzhia hamle me 2 mare, 40 ghayal
items.detail: Raat bhar ke hamle me Zaporizhzhia ki paanch-manzila imarat ko nuksan pahuncha; 2 log mare, ghayalon ki sankhya badhkar 40 hui jinme 4 bachche bhi hain. Corrected: pehle 22 ghayal bataye gaye the.

items.headline: Sanofi kharedega Insmed, $41 billion ka sauda
items.detail: France ki Sanofi ne America ki Insmed ko $41 billion me khareedne ka samjhauta kiya, saans ki bimariyon ki dawaon ke liye; sauda 2027 ki pehli chhamahi me band hone ki ummeed hai.
items.exam_angle: Teen saal ki sabse badi pharma deal — economy

items.headline: Colombia me car bomb, governor karyalaya tabah
items.detail: Villavicencio me Meta governor karyalaya ke paas car bomb phata, darjanon log ghayal hue, koi maut nahi; rashtrapati ne drug taskaron ko zimmedaar thahraya.

items.headline: Hanoi me gas visfot, 6 mare, 10 ghayal
items.detail: Hanoi me ek khane ki dukaan par subah gas visfot hua, imarat ka hissa gira aur 6 log mare gaye, 10 ghayal hue; bachav kaam jaari hai.

items.headline: Gaza hamle me 6 mare, 5 ghayal
items.detail: Mangalvaar ko Khan Younis police chauki par hamle me 3 aur Netzarim ke paas 3 log mare gaye; 5 ghayal hue.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhviram ke baad bhi hamle — manaviya sthiti

items.headline: Norway-Ukraine: naya DESNA raksha system
items.detail: Norway aur Ukraine ne drone-rodhi DESNA vayu-raksha system par sahyog badhaya; Ukrainian missile aur Kongsberg control se bana system pehle se istemal me hai.
items.exam_angle: Drone-rodhi vayu raksha, NATO sahyog — UPSC defence

items.headline: Huckabee: Israel ko madad saal-ant tak jaari?
items.detail: America ke Israel rajdoot Huckabee ne kaha saal ke ant tak $3.8 arab ki sainya madad band hone par unhe sandeh hai; samjhauta 2028 tak chalta hai aur Congress ki manzoori zaroori hai.
items.exam_angle: America-Israel sainya madad, MoU 2028 — UPSC IR

items.headline: Merz: Europe Russia se baat ko taiyaar
items.detail: German Chancellor Merz ne kaha Europe Russia se Ukraine par vaarta ko taiyaar hai; salahakar-stariya baatcheet jaldi Abu Dhabi me phir ho sakti hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine shanti vaarta, Abu Dhabi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Hormuz me 2 aur tanker mine se takraye
items.detail: Iran ki sena ne dawa kiya ki Mangalvaar subah Hormuz ke poorvi hisse me 2 tel tanker mine se takrakar aag ki lapet me aa gaye; is dawe ki swatantra pushti abhi baaki hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz — duniya ki tel supply ka raasta

items.headline: Yemen me August se 3.6 lakh visthapit
items.detail: UN ke mutabik August se Yemen me ladai ke kaaran 3.6 lakh se zyada log visthapit hue; 323 nagrik hatahat hue, jinme 76 ki maut hui.
items.exam_angle: Yemen manaviya sankat, UNHCR — UPSC IR

items.headline: Virginia, Oregon ne Grok par mukadma kiya
items.detail: Virginia aur Oregon ne SpaceX par mukadma kiya, aarop hai Grok ki 'spicy mode' se bina sahmati ke yaun tasveerein bani; pehli baar rajyon ne AI company par mukadma kiya.
items.exam_angle: AI suraksha, upbhokta kanoon — UPSC S&T

items.headline: UK ne Myanmar ke 5 generalon par pratibandh
items.detail: ICJ ke narsanhar faisle ke baad UK ne Myanmar ke 5 varishth sainya adhikariyon par pratibandh lagaye; vimanan indhan niryaat par rok ki yojana bhi ghoshit ki.
items.exam_angle: ICJ narsanhar faisla, UK pratibandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: Serbia school me golibari, 2 ghayal
items.detail: Kragujevac ke First Technical School me 17 saal ke chhatra ne rifle se goli chalayi; ek karmchari ko goli lagi, dusra kanch se ghayal hua, koi chhatra ghayal nahi hua aur hamlaawar giraftaar hai.

items.headline: Iraq ne Kurdistan ke tel-kshetra par kabza liya
items.detail: PM Ali al-Zaidi ne tel taskari jaanch ke baad Kurdistan ke saare border crossing aur 4 pranton ke tel-kshetra sanghiya niyantran me lene ka aadesh diya; Kurdistan ke PM ne is faisle ko kharij kar diya.
items.exam_angle: Iraq-Kurdistan tel vivad - West Asia IR

items.headline: Honda ne 8.1 lakh gaadiyaan wapas bulayi
items.detail: America me Honda ne 8,10,592 purani gaadiyon ko Takata airbag inflator ke fatne ke khatre par wapas bulaya; Toyota ne bhi duniya bhar me 7.9 lakh gaadiyaan wapas bulayi, koi haadsa nahi hua.

items.headline: Lebanon par Israel ke hamle, koi hatahat nahi
items.detail: Mangalvaar ko Israel ne America ki madhyasthata wale samjhaute ke bawjood dakshin Lebanon ke Nabatieh, Marjayoun, Bint Jbeil aur Tyre jilon me hawai hamle aur golabari ki; Lebanon ki sarkari news agency NNA ke mutabik koi hatahat nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Israel-Lebanon yuddhaviram — UPSC IR

items.headline: Trump ke dabav se Huang phir Nvidia CEO
items.detail: Nvidia board ne Jensen Huang ko CEO ke roop me wapas bahaal kiya — isteefe ke 11 din baad; Trump ne board se seedhi baat kar unki wapsi ka dabav banaya tha, aur ghoshna ke baad Nvidia ke share tezi se badhe.
items.exam_angle: Trump-Nvidia: corporate governance

items.headline: Colombia me drone hamla, 3 ghayal
items.detail: Somvaar subah visfotak se lade drone ne Colombia ke Cúcuta shahar me police base par hamla kiya; 18 mahine ke bachche samet 3 nagrik ghayal hue aur 60 ghar kshatigrast hue; hamle ki zimmedari kisi ne nahi li.
items.exam_angle: Colombia: drone hamle — UPSC IR
